==English== {{wp}} ===Alternative forms=== * {{alt|en|'ow}} * {{alt|en|hoo||Northumbrian}} * {{alt|en|whow||obsolete}} ===Pronunciation=== * {{enPR|hou}} ** {{a|en|UK}} *** {{IPA|en|/haʊ/|a=RP}} **** {{audio|en|en-uk-how.ogg|a=London}} *** {{IPA|en|/huː/|a=Northumbrian}} ** {{IPA|en|/haʊ/|a=GA,CA}} *** {{audio|en|en-us-how.ogg|a=California}} *** {{IPA|en|/hʌʊ/|[həu̯]|a=Dialectal}} ** {{IPA|en|/hæɔ/|a=AU}} ** {{IPA|en|/hæʊ/|a=NZ}} ** {{IPA|en|/hæʊ/|a=IE}} * {{rhymes|en|aʊ|s=1}} ===Etymology 1=== {{wikidata lexeme|L65}} {{etymon|en|id=interrogative|:inh|enm:how|tree=1}} {{root|en|ine-pro|*kʷ-}} From {{inh|en|enm|how}}, {{m|enm|hou}}, {{m|enm|hu}}, {{m|enm|hwu}}, from {{inh|en|ang|hū}}, from {{inh|en|gmw-pro|*hwō}}, from {{inh|en|gem-pro|*hwō|t=through what, how}}, from the same root as {{m|ang|hwæt||who, what}}. /hw/ > /h/ due to [[w:Wh-cluster reductions|''wh''-cluster reduction]] in Old English; compare {{m|en|who}}, which underwent this change later, and thus is spelt ''wh'' (Middle English spelling of /hw/) but pronounced /h/ (it previously had a different vowel, hence avoided the spelling and sound change in Old English). Vowel change per [[Great Vowel Shift]]. Akin to {{cog|sco|hoo}}, {{m|sco|foo||how}}, {{cog|frr|ho}}, {{m|frr|hü}}, {{m|frr|hur|t=how}}, {{cog|stq|wo||how}}, {{cog|fy|hoe||how}}, {{cog|nl|hoe||how}}, {{cog|nds|ho}}, {{m|nds|wo}}, {{m|nds|wu||how}}, {{cog|de|wie||how}}, {{cog|sv|hur||how}}. See {{m|en|who}} and compare {{m|en|why}}. ====Adverb==== {{en-adv|-}} # {{lb|en|interrogative|degree}} To [[what]] [[degree]] or [[extent]]. #: {{ux|en|'''How''' often do you practice?}} #: {{ux|en|The gauge indicated '''how''' hot the oven was.}} #: {{ux|en|'''How''' soon can I see the doctor?}} #* {{RQ:Churchill Celebrity|chapter=IV|page=46|passage=No matter '''how''' early I came down, I would find him on the veranda, smoking cigarettes, or otherwise his man would be there with a message to say that his master would shortly join me if I would kindly wait.}} #* {{quote-book|en|year=2013|author=Diane Sullivan Everstine; Louis Everstine|title=Strategic Interventions for People in Crisis, Trauma, and Disaster: Revised Edition|publisher=Routledge|isbn=9781136749391 |passage='''How''' damaged is her self-esteem?}} # {{lb|en|interrogative}} In what [[manner]]: #* {{RQ:Economist|date=2013-08-03|volume=408|issue=8847 |title=[http://www.economist.com/news/finance-and-economics/21582498-america-has-changed-way-it-measures-gdp-boundary-problems Boundary problems]| passage=Economics is a messy discipline: too fluid to be a science, too rigorous to be an art. Perhaps it is fitting that economists’ most-used metric, gross domestic product (GDP), is a tangle too.{{...}}But as a foundation for analysis it is highly subjective: it rests on difficult decisions about what counts as a territory, what counts as output and '''how''' to value it. Indeed, economists are still tweaking it.}} ## By what [[means]]. ##: {{syn|en|wherewithal|qq1=archaic|[[wherein]] (literary)}} ##: {{ux|en|'''How''' do you solve this puzzle? –Sorry, I can't remember '''how'''.}} ##: {{ux|en|'''How''' else can we get this finished?}} ##: {{ux|en|She showed him '''how''' to do it.}} ## {{ng|With overtones of {{m|en|why}}, {{m|en|what|for what reason}}.}} ##: {{ux|en|'''How''' should I know whether he likes raisins or not? Ask him!}} ## In what [[form]], [[shape]], [[measure]], [[quantity]], etc. ##: {{ux|en|'''How''' are you fixed for money?}} ##: {{ux|en|'''How '''did you vote in the last election?}} ##: {{ux|en|[[how do you like|'''How''' do you like]] it here?}} ##* {{quote-book|en|year=1831|author=Nicolas Wanostrocht|title=A Grammar of the French Language: With Practical Exercises|page=372 |passage='''How''' do you sell your brandy?   We sell it by the gallon, and not by the bottle.}} ##* {{quote-book|en|year=2005|author=Tim Stafford|title=Knowing the Face of God, Revised Edition: Deepening Your Personal Relationship with God|publisher=Wipf and Stock Publishers|isbn=9781597523936|page=191 |passage='''How''' does God appear in these religions? Hinduism has a thousand faces for God, some likable, some horrible. You can pick and choose your preferred image. Buddhism does not even have an image of God, but concentrates on man.}} ## With what [[meaning]] or [[effect]]. ##: {{ux|en|'''How''' the stock market interprets events has real consequences.}} ##* {{quote-book|en|year=1906|title=Gibbons Stamp Weekly|page=110 |passage=A heap of stamps? Yes. Stamps they were indeed, hundreds of penny Queen's Heads neatly mounted on the original sheets. "Good God!" exclaimed Mr. Erskine as he turned to Mr. Sackville, "'''how''' am I to take this, sir?" said he severely. "Where are the real stamps? Were they ever inside, ever in your possession at all? If it is a joke, it is a very poor one."}} ## By what [[title]] or what [[name]]. ##* {{quote-book|en|year=1907|author=Edward Byles Cowell|title=The Jātaka: Or, Stories of the Buddha's Former Births|page=44 |passage="'''How''' art thou called? '''How''' a score of ewes now?

Thereafter as they be: a score of good ewes may be worth ten pounds.}} # {{lb|en|interrogative}} In what [[state]] or [[condition]]. #: {{ux|en|'''How''' are you?}} #: {{ux|en|'''How''' was your vacation?}} # {{lb|en|fused relative}} In the [[manner]] in which. #: {{ux|en|I said it exactly '''how''' he said it.}} # {{lb|en|fused relative}} In any [[manner]] in which; in whatever [[way]]; [[however]]. #: {{ux|en|People should be free to live '''how''' they want.}} # {{lb|en|relative|nonstandard|modifying a word like {{m|en|way}} or {{m|en|manner}}}} In which. #: {{ux|en|The way '''how''' you walk is funny.}} # {{lb|en|[[exclamative marker|exclamative]]}} {{ng|Used as a modifier to indicate [[surprise]], [[delight]], or other strong [[feeling]]s in an [[exclamation]].}} #: {{ux|en|'''How''' very interesting!}} #: {{ux|en|'''How''' wonderful it was to receive your invitation.}} #* {{quote-song|en|year=1973|lyricist=|composer=|title={{w|Yesterday Once More (song)|Yesterday Once More}}|album={{w|Now & Then (The Carpenters album)|Now & Then}}|artist=w:the Carpenters|passage=Those were such happy times and not so long ago / '''How''' I wondered where they'd gone}} #* {{quote-web|en|date=July 7 2021|author=w:Phil McNulty|work=BBC Sport|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/51198755|title=England 2-1 Denmark|passage='''How''' England had to fight for victory against this steely Denmark with an inspired keeper in {{w|Kasper Schmeichel}}, especially after conceding their first goal of the tournament to {{w|Mikkel Damsgaard}}'s stunning free-kick after 30 minutes.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20250801130657/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/51198755|archivedate=1 August 2025}} =====Usage notes===== * See usage notes on {{m|en|else|pos=adv}}. * ''How good is it?'' means "To what extent is it good?", whereas ''How is it good?'' means "In what manner is it good?". Likewise, ''I know how good it is'' means "I know the extent to which it is good", whereas ''I know how it is good'' means "I know the manner in which it is good". =====Derived terms=====
